chapter: Georgie Auld, Hawkins and Los Angeles
title: Chicago, Philadelphia and back to New York
summary: Playing in the park with Fats and Dizzy, a month at the Downbeat Club in Philadelphia, then New York in December 1944.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: But anyway, then I went to Chicago, and I hung out there. And I think Fats and Dizzy came through there. So we went out in the park and played in the mornings, just jivin' around.
Yeah, out there somewhere... Near 55th Street, whatever that park is. [WASHINGTON PARK]. That's Grant or Jackson, I don't know which...one of those guys anyway.

But anyway, I told Fats that I was coming back to New York if I could. In the meantime, I got a call from Nat Segal. He had the Downbeat Club in Philly. So he said, 'Maggie, why don't you come on in here if you ain't doin' nothin'.' So I went to Philly, and I stayed there for about a month just playing in the club, living in New York, but I'd go down there... I'd drive down there every night.
